Foiley 1.2 adds airfoil generators:
* NACA 4-digit, 5-digit (standard and reflexed), 4-digit modified,
  16-series, 6-series and 6A-series sections;
* CST, PARSEC, Kármán–Trefftz and cambered-plate sections. The optimizer can now also
vary CST weights.

## NACA families

Type a designation in **Foil design → Create**. You can also give one
anywhere a foil is accepted on the command line, such as
`foiley foil polar "NACA 64(2)-415"`, or use
`foiley foil gen naca "<code>"`.

- **5-digit, now complete:** reflexed mean lines (`23112`, 221xx to 251xx,
  nominally zero moment about c/4) and any design lift coefficient (first
  digit × 0.15: `13012`, `43012`).
- **Closed trailing edge** for 4- and 5-digit sections (`2412 closed TE`):
  the x⁴ coefficient is −0.1036 instead of −0.1015.
- **4-digit modified** (`0012-64`, also with a 5-digit mean line such as
  `23015-64`) and **16-series** (`16-009`, `16-212`).
- **6-series** (`63-206`, `64(2)-415` or `64₂-415`, `65-415 a=0.5`; 63 to 67,
  plus Report 824's `65(318)-217` notation) and **6A-series** (`64A010`,
  `63A210`, `64(2)A215`), from NASA's conformal-mapping data.

Each family is built the way its NACA report defines it, with the thickness
perpendicular to the mean line. Every code XFoil's own `NACA` command
accepts generates exactly what it did in 1.1 and in XFoil: any 1- to
4-digit code, and 210xx–250xx. All 10,500 codes are checked bit for bit,
and saved projects are not affected.

## CST, PARSEC, Kármán–Trefftz and cambered plates

- **CST (Kulfan):**
  - Edit the weights with a live preview.
  - *Fit to selected foil* fits CST weights to a foil, including a loaded
    `.dat`, by least squares and reports the fit error. A fit whose surfaces
    would cross is refused with a suggestion to lower the order.
  - Command line: `foiley foil fit-cst FOIL --order 8 [--json]` and
    `foiley foil gen cst`.
- **PARSEC:** Sobieczky's 11 parameters (LE radius, crests, TE height,
  thickness, direction and wedge), solved per surface.
- **Kármán–Trefftz:** Joukowsky with a finite trailing-edge angle. The exact
  inviscid CL and Cm are shown next to the parameters
  (`foiley foil gen kt --exact 0,4`).
- **Cambered plates:** constant thickness, circular-arc or parabolic camber
  and a round leading edge, for very low Reynolds numbers.
  - The default trailing edge is square-cut (`--te square`), which XFoil
    analyses.
  - A round trailing edge (`--te round`) is available for geometry, but
    XFoil's viscous solution does not converge on it.

Generated foils keep their recipe. **Edit parameters** reopens it, and
**Replace selected** applies a new shape to an existing foil while keeping
its name and hinge. Generators reject parameters whose contour would cross
itself.

AVL export writes a native `NACA` line only when the foil's coordinates are
that section. A foil reshaped under a NACA name is exported as a file.

## Optimizer

Under **Shape variables**, choose **CST weights** instead of Hicks–Henne
bumps (`foiley foil optimize --shape cst --cst-order 5`). The genes are
changes of the CST weights added to the base foil. Zero genes reproduce the
base foil exactly. Each gene changes thickness, camber or the LE radius
over the whole chord, without local waviness. Settings saved by 1.1 load as
Hicks–Henne.

## Checks

| Item | Check |
|---|---|
| 5-digit (incl. reflexed), 4-digit modified, 16-, 6- and 6A-series match NASA's NACA4/NACA6 ordinates within 1.6e-5 c aft of x/c 0.0125 (5-decimal tables; up to 1.9e-4 c at the nose) | `naca_reference.rs` |
| All 10,500 codes XFoil accepts are bit-identical to 1.1 | `every_code_xfoil_accepts_is_unchanged` |
| Report 824 `(318)` notation scales the basic form; LE index 9 is three times the normal radius | `report_824_form_thickness_scales_the_basic_form`, `le_index_9_is_three_times_the_normal_radius` |
| Self-crossing contours, folding plates, PARSEC troughs and runaway crests, and unsupported CST exponents or inverted edges are rejected | `crossing_contours_are_found`, `folding_plates_are_rejected`, `bad_parameters_are_rejected`, `unsupported_class_exponents_and_inverted_edges_are_rejected` |
| The exact Kármán–Trefftz moment (Blasius) matches a 400,000-point pressure integration | `blasius_moment_matches_a_converged_pressure_integral` |
| AVL export uses `NACA` only for foils that are that section | `a_foil_reshaped_under_a_naca_name_is_exported_as_a_file` |
| Invalid CST optimiser settings are input errors, not panics | `cst_genes_change_the_shape_smoothly` |
| Reflexed mean lines have zero thin-airfoil Cm about c/4 | `reflexed_mean_line_has_zero_moment` |
| XFoil inviscid CL within 0.3% and Cm within 4e-4 of the exact Kármán–Trefftz solution | `karman_trefftz.rs` |
| One section per family converges in a viscous analysis | `families.rs` |
| CST fits (NACA 2412 order 8: max 2e-4 c) and exact recovery of CST weights | `fitting_naca_sections_is_accurate`, `a_fit_of_a_cst_foil_recovers_its_weights` |
| PARSEC surfaces meet all 11 conditions | `the_surfaces_meet_every_condition` |
| CST optimizer genes: neutral genes give the base foil; old settings load as Hicks–Henne | `cst_genes_change_the_shape_smoothly` |
| Recipes round-trip through project JSON | `recipes_round_trip_through_json` |
| Clippy gate passes | `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` |

## Known limit

**What fails.** Thin 6-series sections with a high design CL on the a = 1.0
mean line, such as NACA 63-406, end in a near-cusped, hooked trailing edge.
XFoil's sharp-trailing-edge condition then gives a wrong inviscid solution;
it does the same with NASA's own ordinates.

**Workarounds.** Add a 0.05% TE gap (*Modify → TE gap*) or use an a < 1
mean line. 63-206, 63-412, 64(2)-415, 65-610 and 66-209 solve normally.
